indexes.scope: Curated syntax block Markdown in the exact source revision of the dated syntax website.
indexes.limitations: Includes every source file in each application's doc/content/syntax. Conditional and generated registrations are independently inventoried from source when available. An app must compile/load its modules to expose their syntax.

indexes.scope: Exact-version framework and module source-reference Markdown pages under each doc/content/source, per app and system.
indexes.limitations: Some pages describe infrastructure or abstract classes. The generated Complete Syntax can reuse entries in many blocks. The denominator uses each unresolved source-reference path once. Where source owner, category and registered class match exactly, the documentation URL is attached to the existing registration.

indexes.scope: Exact-version registerMooseObject and registerMooseAction definitions for framework, modules and combined apps; syntax association macros.
indexes.limitations: Registration identity is app + object, or app + action task; syntax associations retain block path. Macro wrappers outside the listed patterns, conditional availability, test apps and dependent applications are outside this denominator.

indexes.scope: Fixed-version main input decks selected during reverse cross-check of existing MOOSE engineering cards.
indexes.limitations: Curated verified main decks rather than an inventory of every upstream test. One deck exercises a particular assembly and cannot establish product execution or every variant of its related knowledge card.

indexes.scope: framework 和 modules 生产代码 validParams 中以常量名称直接注册的公开输入和耦合变量；按定义文件、类、参数名分别计数。
indexes.limitations: 继承输入只在声明处计数。不含运行时生成名、宏间接声明、自定义应用，以及无法从静态函数体解析的参数。参数条目与对象条目分别保留。

features.name: Two-species aqueous equilibrium transport
features.reason: The deck is a two-primary-species example. The existing card does not pin its equilibrium reactions, log K values or transport conditions.

features.name: Three-dimensional frictional mortar contact
features.reason: The fixed example selects a 3D mortar formulation. The card leaves the mortar objects, tangential regularization and solver parameters open.

features.name: Electrostatic interface with supplied conductance
features.reason: The specified conductance contact branch matches the card scope. Material properties, paired-trace mapping and prescribed current or voltage conditions remain unpinned.

features.name: Scalar complex Helmholtz split-field test
features.reason: The benchmark provides the paired real/imaginary scalar equations. The card does not pin this object pair or its boundary and excitation conditions.

features.name: Water97 single-phase fluid property example
features.reason: The benchmark pins the water property model, whereas the card describes the generic pressure–temperature route without pinning this model or its valid states.

features.name: AD ALE flow–solid interface in a transient flat channel
features.reason: The case assembles moving-mesh flow, structural response and a penalty interface. The card does not pin the penalty, subdomain mesh coupling or time integration.

features.name: Two-dimensional interface functional expansion transfer
features.reason: The cross-application example transfers a finite modal representation. The card omits the concrete basis orders, normalization and source/destination mapping.

features.name: Quartz dissolution kinetics test
features.reason: The deck identifies the mineral reaction, solver and chemistry database. The card lacks the exact database assumptions and kinetic constants for this upstream case.

features.name: Conjugate heat transfer example
features.reason: Fluid and solid heat transport are assembled together in this documented deck. The old card does not identify the exact interface or integration objects.

features.name: RadiationTransfer action for diffuse-gray exchange
features.reason: The deck links the solid heat equation to surface radiation and view factors. The card lacks its sideset, emissivity, ambient and view-factor setup contract.

features.name: Level set transport in a prescribed vortex
features.reason: The benchmark uses a prescribed vortex velocity to advect the interface. The card leaves its discretization and choice of reinitialization open.

features.name: Compressible HLLC Sod shock tube
features.reason: This deck assembles mass, momentum and energy HLLC fluxes for ideal gas. It covers one branch of the card and does not pin the generic application geometry and state model.

features.name: Finite-volume incompressible skewed vortex
features.reason: The card includes the incompressible FV branch. It does not pin the flow action's face reconstruction, numerical boundary data or manufactured-source setup.

features.name: Inverse heat-source coefficient through Optimize
features.reason: The main input connects a heat PDE and objective reporter through MultiApps. The card omits the concrete measurements, transfer setup and optimization controls.

features.name: H1NOSPD small-strain mechanics Jacobian benchmark
features.reason: This deck fixes a small-strain nonordinary state-based formulation and neighborhood treatment. The card leaves the exact horizon, stabilization and boundary discretization open.

features.name: Elemental Darcy velocity auxiliary test
features.reason: This deck pins the Darcy velocity postprocessing for specified pressures and porous materials. It does not cover the old card's full engineering pressure-boundary workflow.

features.name: Fully saturated 1D heat advection with porous flow Action
features.reason: This fully saturated 1D configuration exercises the card's transport route. The card does not give the action and material configuration for this deck.

features.name: Mandel poroelastic problem through BasicTHM
features.reason: The deck exercises the pore-pressure and solid-deformation part through BasicTHM; Mandel does not verify the complete thermal-feedback branch of the card.

features.name: One-dimensional AEFV square-wave advection
features.reason: The deck exercises the stated AEFV reconstruction on a square wave. The card omits its exact transport problem configuration and finite-volume executable registration.

features.name: Broadbridge–White unsaturated Richards benchmark
features.reason: This deck pins constitutive functions and pressure transport for one unsaturated case. The card omits concrete kernel and retention configuration.

features.name: Finite-strain elastic stress update test
features.reason: This deck uses the finite-strain elastic calculator for one strain and loading path. The old card omits the exact integration and strain convention.

features.name: Monte Carlo parameter study Action
features.reason: The upstream study provides a configured sampler/distribution. The card does not pin its sampled variables, probability laws, seed and reporter statistics.

features.name: Solid master application coupled to a single-phase 1D channel
features.reason: This parent deck configures solid wall-temperature and channel-property transfers. The old card omits roles, transfer schedule and axis-alignment details.

features.name: Tutorial single-phase flow channel
features.reason: This exact tutorial initializes the three-equation channel. The generic old card does not specify its geometry, fluid properties or inlet and outlet construction.

features.name: XFEM edge crack with prescribed cut
features.reason: This deck specifies one stationary 2D crack and its tip treatment. The card leaves restart, cut geometry and enriched formulation selection generic.
